item.title: Storefront Brief issue 7: Product Page Optimization in App Store Connect — organic A/B tests on the default page
item.description: English issue: Product Page Optimization (PPO) lets indie iOS teams run Connect-managed A/B tests on app icons, screenshots, and app preview videos against the default product page — treatment vs control, traffic split, conversion metric, 90-day cap, per-locale treatments. item.title: Storefront Brief issue 6: In-App Event pages in App Store Connect — time-boxed campaign surface after your first CPP
item.description: English issue: In-App Events (live in Connect since 2022) give indie iOS teams a time-boxed event card and event details page on the product page, in search, and on Today/Games/Apps — the campaign layer after Custom Product Pages from Issue 5. Per-locale name, short description, long description, and event image; App Review reviews each event. Ship one event matching your first CPP keyword intent. Creative Assets 4+ ceiling applies to event media. Not a fee change. Operator intel, not legal advice. Buy/Checkout: https://buy.stripe.com/6oUcMZ17IbCk4X3dmle7m02
